deployments_detail.use: Shift Technology generative-AI 'visual intelligence' added to deployed Shift Claims Fraud Detection and Shift Claims Intake, extracting data from structured/unstructured documents and images to improve fraud detection and claims processing accuracy. [Shift Technology]
"One-AI for Tokio Marine" company-wide generative AI (ChatGPT, from 2023); OpenAI strategic partnership (ChatGPT Enterprise/GPT-5, 2025)
"TMAM AI" generative AI for investment analysis (company-wide Apr 2025); Sakana AI capital alliance

Strategic collaboration with OpenAI to embed generative AI (ChatGPT Enterprise, GPT-5) across contracts, inquiries and document processing, with AI agents for high-value customer experiences. First step: ChatGPT Deep Research automatically collects local demographics for Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire sales strategy formulation. [OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise, GPT-5)]

Tractable computer-vision AI (Loss Adjuster Application) analyzes vehicle damage photos to recommend repair methods, paint operations and labor hours in auto claims - the first major Japanese insurer to deploy AI auto damage assessment into the claims process. Deployed at a claim service center from April 2020. [Tractable]
deployments_detail.value: Claims processing cut from 2-3 weeks toward minutes

deployments_detail.use: Uses ICEYE synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite imagery plus AI analysis to rapidly assess natural-disaster damage extent (e.g., flood depth, building damage) and accelerate insurance payouts; used on real events including the 2021 Atami landslide. [ICEYE]
deployments_detail.value: Damage assessed within a few days vs. traditional ~two weeks

deployments_detail.use: Tokio Marine partnered with Voxel to pilot computer-vision AI that uses existing security cameras to detect real-time workplace safety hazards and prevent injuries before they happen; piloted inside a Michaels distribution center in California (loss-prevention / risk mitigation for policyholders). [Voxel]

Tokio Marine Kiln, with Convex and broker McGill and Partners, launched an AI-powered trade disruption insurance facility that uses AI to model and cover supply-chain / trade disruption risks. [Tokio Marine Kiln / Convex / McGill and Partners]

Strategic partnership with Salesforce Japan to build AI-enabled contact centers using Agentforce autonomous AI agents (seamless enrollment to after-sales service) and combine customer data platforms with AI to recommend tailored insurance solutions; redesign of sales branch, agency and contact-center processes. [Salesforce (Agentforce)]

Tokio Marine Indonesia (PT Asuransi Tokio Marine Indonesia) deployed WIZ.AI conversational voice AI 'Talkbot' to automate customer-service calls, handling initial interactions and routing complex cases to human agents. [WIZ.AI]
deployments_detail.value: Over 95% of callers unable to distinguish the AI from a human agent
